config.label: The token tools act with
config.description: The token tools act with. To post, use a community token: Manage -> API usage -> Access tokens -> Create token (wall, photos, stories, messages, manage) — no app needed, tied to neither a browser nor an IP. It posts, comments and publishes stories, but VK refuses it wall reads; set VK_SERVICE_KEY for those. Guide: https://github.com/bulatko/vk-mcp-server/blob/master/docs/SETUP.md

config.label: Optional service key from your VK app's settings page
config.description: Optional service key from your VK app's settings page. Reads public profiles and walls; reads the access token is refused are made with it. Never used for writes.
